425:t_1:83.en:
$n
「That helps. Everyone, please lend me your strength.」

425:t_1:84.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(It seems there's no need to worry.)

425:t_1:86.en:
$$アルト$$
「...It sounds like the $$中央大陸$$ team had a rough time too.」

425:t_1:87.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah. We fought one battle after another, across Japan and the $$中央大陸$$.」

425:t_1:88.en:
$$甲児$$
「Plus, we found out Emperor $$ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ are alive.」

425:t_1:89.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then was that mysterious robot army theirs?」

425:t_1:90.en:
$$タケル$$
「No... They weren't $$ズール$$'s servants.」

425:t_1:91.en:
$$ルカ$$
「So in the end, that unmanned army's identity is still a mystery.」

425:t_1:92.en:
$$クラン$$
「And on top of that, $$ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ are alive...」

425:t_1:93.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$ is investigating the details for us.」

425:t_1:94.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I heard you met him again at the center of the galaxy. Has he come to Earth?」

425:t_1:95.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Yes. $$グーラ$$ thinks the growing dark power of $$ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ is dangerous, so he's investigating it.」

425:t_1:96.en:
$$アルト$$
「I hope you get to fight alongside him someday, $$正太郎$$.」

425:t_1:97.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I believe that day will come.」

425:t_1:98.en:
$$勝平$$
「I don't know about dark power or whatever, but $$ザンボット$$'s powered up too. Whatever comes, I'm not scared.」

425:t_1:99.en:
$$クラン$$
「Relying on power so quickly like that is proof you're a child, $$勝平$$.」

425:t_1:100.en:
$$勝平$$
「You're the last person I want to hear that from, Sis $$クラン$$.」

425:t_1:101.en:
$$クラン$$
「I only look young! Mentally, I'm a mature woman!」

425:t_1:102.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「If you're seriously losing your temper over $$勝平$$'s teasing, you're not very convincing.」

425:t_1:104.en:
$$アルト$$
「If he's not here, he's probably running simulations or something.」

425:t_1:105.en:
$$カレン$$
「Maybe he's practicing Jeet Kune Do.」

425:t_1:106.en:
$$アマタ$$
「He's so serious about it, even though $$ジェニオン$$ has already powered up.」

425:t_1:107.en:
$$宗介$$
「Daily discipline produces results in battle. A soldier who neglects regular training will never win.」

425:t_1:108.en:
$$カイエン$$
「$$宗介$$ is right. You should follow $n's example a little, $$アマタ$$.」

425:t_1:109.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I thought I was doing a decent amount already...」

425:t_1:110.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But the source of $$アクエリオン$$'s power is your love, right, $$アマタ$$?」

425:t_1:111.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So getting all lovey-dovey with $$ミコノ$$ is training!」

425:t_1:116.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'd love to hear the details.」

425:t_1:118.en:
$$アマタ$$
(Oh, I can't get enough of that bashfulness!)

425:t_1:119.en:
$$アルト$$
「You two really are easy to read.」

425:t_1:120.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Still, it's true that $n's training sometimes goes beyond anything reasonable.」

425:t_1:121.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I agree. I've trained with him too, and it's... a little abnormal.」

425:t_1:122.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But it's also true that it brings us victories...」

425:t_1:125.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ジェニオン$$'s $$スフィア$$, the $$いがみ合う双子$$, uses opposing emotions as the key to activating its power...」

425:t_1:126.en:
$$シン$$
「That's the hope and despair inside $n, right?」

425:t_1:127.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Things haven't exactly been smooth sailing, but $n has overcome hardship and won time after time...」

425:t_1:128.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I think the key was his refusal to give up... his belief in hope.」

425:t_1:129.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I think so too. $n has always fought with faith in hope...」

425:t_1:131.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It seems you've realized it, $$アルト$$.」

425:t_1:132.en:
$$アルト$$
「$n is activating the $$スフィア$$... If that's true...」

425:t_1:133.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then there's always as much despair in him as there is hope.」

425:t_1:134.en:
$$シン$$
「Wait...! That would mean the despair inside him is enormous!」

425:t_1:135.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Could it be about his father and sister, who he said died in a $$時空震動$$...?」

425:t_1:136.en:
$$カレン$$
「And the $$テンシ$$ that he said caused it...」

425:t_1:138.en:
$$カイエン$$
「What makes you say that?」

425:t_1:139.en:
$$アルト$$
「That incident and the $$テンシ$$ certainly wounded and frightened $n.」

425:t_1:140.en:
$$アルト$$
「But by fighting in $$ジェニオン$$, he gradually overcame them.」

425:t_1:141.en:
$$宗介$$
「I agree. Those are $n's reasons to fight. Despair would be something different.」

425:t_1:142.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah... If there's a hardship, he's the sort of guy who fights to overcome it.」

425:t_1:143.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then is the despair $n carries something he can't overcome, no matter what he does?」

425:t_1:145.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Despair that can't be overcome...」

425:t_1:147.en:
$$宗介$$
「...There's no point in us speculating.」

425:t_1:149.en:
$$アルト$$
「But this is $n's problem. It's probably rooted so deep inside him that he can't even tell us about it.」

425:t_1:150.en:
$$シン$$
「So he's the only one who can solve it...」

425:t_1:151.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What we need to do now is capture the southern $$中央大陸$$ as soon as possible.」

425:t_1:152.en:
$$カイエン$$
「If we crush $$サイデリアル$$ in this area, the $$翠の地球$$ will be as good as liberated.」

425:t_1:153.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Which means $$サイデリアル$$ will gather its remaining forces from every region.」

425:t_1:154.en:
$$甲児$$
「Any movements from the $$蒼の地球$$?」

425:t_1:155.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ is in space keeping watch on that front. We'll hear immediately if there's any large-scale movement.」

425:t_1:156.en:
$n
「Oh, so you were all in the salon.」

425:t_1:158.en:
$n
「What's wrong, $$カレン$$? You're looking at me with tears in your eyes...」

425:t_1:159.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Don't tell me you have a thing for $n too!?」

425:t_1:160.en:
$$カレン$$
「No way! Not for a clueless idiot like him...!」

425:t_1:161.en:
$n
「...It's better than being called the quiet type, but hearing it so bluntly still gets me down...」
